canonical_project: DataVolt NEOM Oxagon net-zero AI factory campus
notes: NEOM announced a DataVolt agreement for a phased Oxagon AI/data-center campus; phase one is funded by an initial USD 5 billion investment and expected operational by 2028. Oxagon is on the Red Sea coast in NEOM; assigned to Duba because Oxagon/Port of NEOM is generally associated with the Duba coastal area.
